name: Onyx-Drift
description: Onyx-Drift is a world of black water and silver light, its planet-spanning ocean so dense with dissolved minerals that it absorbs nearly all visible light, giving the surface the appearance of liquid obsidian. Beneath the dark surface, bioluminescent organisms create vast constellations of cold blue and violet fire that shift with the tides. Permanent storm fronts girdle the equator, their lightning illuminating the waves in stroboscopic flashes.

The dense atmosphere presses down with tangible weight, and the air tastes of brine and ozone. Sound carries strangely here, the crash of waves arriving seconds before they should, while other noises are swallowed entirely. During the rare calms between storms, the ocean becomes a perfect mirror reflecting the stars, and the boundary between sky and sea vanishes completely.

Deep-ocean sonar surveys have detected a repeating signal originating from somewhere far beneath the surface, a structured pulse that defies natural explanation. No expedition has successfully reached the signal's source; the crushing depths and labyrinthine subterranean ocean channels have defeated every attempt. The indigenous fauna, massive filter-feeding leviathans, seem to navigate by the signal, suggesting it predates their evolution by eons.

Onyx-Drift's fusion fuel reserves and abundant water make it a strategic resupply point, but the signal has attracted the attention of xenoarchaeological institutes and military intelligence alike. Harvesting operations must contend with the leviathans, whose migratory patterns are unpredictable and whose sheer mass can capsize extraction rigs. Whoever or whatever is broadcasting from the deep has waited a very long time, and may not welcome visitors.
